Der Autor zum Buch: Shadow Traffic is based on the dreams received from a number of people (and including my own). The dreams are picked for their truth to our concerns about living. The paper pages are offset from Haloid-Xerox originals ; the ace tate images are photosilkscreened from kodalith originals. The book is the container of many ideas that I have been interested in! The interaction of two or more images (by means of the acetate pages), the interaction of more than one 'word-unit' (piece of writing), the in tegration of words and images (in a way that is more unified than traditional linear type-set-by-machine-across-from-a-picture!), as well as more narrowly visual concerns (interplay of texture and softness, texture against texture etc.). I am an artist who turned to the book-form for a number of reasons. One of the main reasons is the greater complexity of form and content which can come with sequential images. Another, related reason, is t he opportunity to 'marry' words and images, to play them against each other for more complex communication. Another attraction of (the artist's) book for me, (since I mostly think in terms of editions, rather than one-o f-a-kind objects), is the possibility of making artwork available to everyone, not just the wealthy! I also value the private and personal interaction that people can have with books, acting in their own rhythm to t urn the pages, make the association, unfold the event. <dt.>
